claim: Patchline ships an accountable-use policy that maps every autonomous or blocking capability to required human oversight before the capability can be treated as safe. The worker loads a frozen self-repo spec, checks that each autonomous or blocking capability names a human role, a decision point, a review artifact, and gate-backed evidence, and then rejects a negative control whose blocking capability has no required oversight, so the accountable-use claim is reproducible via `make accountable-use-policy-gate`.

capabilities.description: Escrow can release a generated repair candidate only after independent evidence clears thresholds.
capabilities.decision_point: before release badge or merge recommendation
capabilities.review_artifact: repair-escrow manifest with reviewer and certificate thresholds

capabilities.description: Pull-request checks may block when deterministic data-risk findings violate policy.
capabilities.decision_point: before merge block is overridden or accepted
capabilities.review_artifact: finding explanation with evidence paths, policy obligation, and override rationale

capabilities.description: Live calibration can suggest but not apply threshold changes to blocking policy.
capabilities.decision_point: before any high-stakes threshold becomes active
capabilities.review_artifact: policy-freeze decision record plus calibration drift report

capabilities.description: New detectors run in shadow mode until burden and precision gates pass.

bad.description: A blocking rule with no human oversight mapping.
